correctness.rationale: The stated result is correct within the south-pole, nested odd-ring family. On ring k, channel q in [-k,k] has no alias with absolute order at most k other than q; sorting by decreasing absolute order gives triangular signed-order blocks without needing any prior invertibility. The derivative Legendre polynomials have consecutive degrees and the stated normalized leading coefficients. Their Vandermonde products give the ring and spacing powers by counting signed orders; unit-modulus phases leave the determinant modulus invariant. The strictly negative log-curvature of the endpoint factors gives strict concavity in every open ordering chamber, and the product vanishes on its boundary. At L=3 the first derivatives yield the two displayed equations and there is one interior critical point per chamber. Exact evaluation in Q(sqrt(2305)) confirms the positive chamber-value difference and the stated ratio to the equiangular placement.
residual_risks: Finite numerical agreement is not the all-bandwidth proof; no formal verification is claimed.
